_doc: Cleo beta UI string catalogue, Japanese (D-41). Translated from en.json by an AI agent and checked by a separate, independent AI review (design/beta/i18n/ja-REVIEW.md). Not human-reviewed: "reviewed" stays false until a human signs it off; the switcher offers it as the AI-reviewed tier with a visible note. Place names, record write-ups and source names are DATA and are never translated.
